fusions.name: Unheard Approach
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. It has 30% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been wounded yet.

fusions.name: Done Toying
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Pounces you onto it from up to 6 tiles away for a sting that deals 20 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Soundless Hover
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Quarry Out of Reach
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
